description: Examinations with no recorded pattern are excluded before grouping.

a.request: Group the examinations by `ANA Pattern`, leaving out examinations with no recorded pattern, and compute each group's average `aCL IgG` (ignoring missing values). Keep the patterns whose average is above the mean of all the group averages (each group counted once). For each, show the pattern, its average aCL IgG, how far it is above that mean, and how far it is from the mean of the kept patterns' averages.
a.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_mean FROM g WHERE avg_igg IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, g.avg_igg - m.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.overall_mean) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, above_mean, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k

b.request: Excluding examinations with no recorded ANA Pattern (NULL or empty), group the remaining examinations by `ANA Pattern`, compute each pattern's average `aCL IgG` (ignoring NULL values), and list the patterns whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of all pattern averages, showing each pattern, its average, the difference between that average and the cross-pattern mean, and the difference between that average and the mean of the above-average patterns' averages
b.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_all FROM pa WHERE avg_igg IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT pa.pattern, pa.avg_igg FROM pa, overall WHERE pa.avg_igg > overall.mean_all), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_above FROM above) SELECT above.pattern, above.avg_igg AS average_aCL_IgG, above.avg_igg - overall.mean_all AS diff_from_overall_mean, above.avg_igg - above_mean.mean_above AS diff_from_above_mean FROM above, overall, above_mean ORDER BY above.avg_igg DESC

c.request: Which ANA patterns (`ANA Pattern`) have an average `aCL IgG` (ignoring missing values) above the average of all the pattern averages? For each, show the pattern, its average aCL IgG, how far it is above that cross-pattern average, and how far it is from the average of these above-average patterns' averages. Examinations with no recorded pattern are excluded before grouping.
c.sql: WITH pat AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_avg FROM pat WHERE avg_igg IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, p.avg_igg - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM pat p, overall o WHERE p.avg_igg > o.overall_avg) SELECT pattern, avg_igg AS average_aCL_IgG, diff_from_overall AS above_overall_average, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_average FROM above ORDER BY avg_igg DESC

d.request: Which ANA patterns (`ANA Pattern`) have an average `aCL IgG` (ignoring missing values) above the average of all the pattern averages? Exclude examinations with no recorded ANA pattern before grouping. For each qualifying pattern, show the pattern, its average aCL IgG, how far it is above the cross-pattern average, and how far it is from the average of these above-average patterns' averages.
d.sql: WITH pattern_avg AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_avg FROM pattern_avg), above AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, o.overall_avg FROM pattern_avg p, overall o WHERE p.avg_igg > o.overall_avg), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS above_avg FROM above) SELECT a.pattern AS `ANA Pattern`, a.avg_igg AS avg_aCL_IgG, a.avg_igg - a.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, a.avg_igg - m.above_avg AS diff_from_above_avg FROM above a, above_mean m ORDER BY a.avg_igg DESC
